title: VC Scout — pick the composition to build
question: Same Miura world, three compositions. Approve one, or use the steer box to combine (e.g. "B for title and act breaks, C for data slides").

options.label: A · The Ledger Sheet
options.thesis: An engineering drawing you read: flat sheet, giant ink title, data living inside deployed cells.
options.viewport: Controlled and airy; every slide reads like a precision spec document. Motion is subtle cell-by-cell deployment in plane.
options.risk: The quietest of the three — less theatrical unfold, memorability rides on typography and precision.

options.label: B · The Unfolding Stage
options.thesis: The sheet itself performs: dramatic 3D deployment on every act break, titles riding the crease seams.
options.viewport: Maximum spectacle — the paper visibly unfolds in perspective, then facets rotate flat when a chart needs reading.
options.risk: Perspective must always hand off to flat surfaces for dense charts, or legibility suffers at the back of the room.

options.label: C · The Split Board
options.thesis: A folded spine holds the fold-map agenda; a big flat canvas gives every chart maximum projector scale.
options.viewport: Most legible from distance; the persistent M-01…M-13 spine doubles as agenda, progress, and navigation.
options.risk: The spine takes a third of every slide — hero moments get less full-bleed drama.

options.label: Hybrid · Stage + Board
options.thesis: B's dimensional deployment for the title and the four hero moments; C's spine-and-canvas for data slides; A's in-cell data styling throughout.
options.viewport: Act breaks unfold in perspective, then the sheet settles into the split-board reading layout; the fold-map spine collapses to a thin rail during heroes.
options.risk: Two layout modes must feel like one sheet — the transition between them has to be flawless or it reads as two decks.
